$comment: Canonical library data. Edit this file (or ask Claude to), then run: python3 build.py. Each entry's `image` is a filename in library/images/. Vocabulary terms must come from the controlled lists in build.py, which validates them.

entries.title: Crafting Culture, Detroit
entries.brief: A studio portfolio built on scale and contrast. Massive grotesk display type stacked two lines on a white ground, set tight, with no colour at all in the interface. Below it an asymmetric grid of high-contrast editorial photography and 3D render work runs full bleed to the frame edge, so the imagery carries every bit of the colour.

entries.title: Outfit
entries.brief: A storefront that commits entirely to one colour. Saturated red floods the page while the wordmark sits enormous inside a centred light panel, grotesk and knocked out at display scale. A four-up product grid shot in black and white sits beneath, holding its own against the red field.

entries.title: Our Projects, Kim Kneipp
entries.brief: A quiet interiors portfolio on a warm putty ground, with an oversized elegant serif headline in soft grey-green. A hairline motif leads the eye down into a dense index of work, where muted archival-toned photography sits in editorial columns under small captions.
